items.title: BlizzCon 2026 开幕式图文直播：守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft 与 暗黑破坏岛 未来展望即将揭晓，星际争霸…

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/rjavHDbucljkmoj.jpg
2026年暴雪嘉年华（BlizzCon 2026）即将开幕，我们将全程报道开幕式上的所有公告。
这家拥有 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft、星际争霸、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 的公司准备举办一场比以往任何一届暴雪嘉年华都更受瞩目的开幕式。活动将于太平洋时间上午10:30 / 东部时间下午1:30 / 英国时间下午6:30开始，我们将从主舞台发回现场报道。
星际争霸
塔防, 免费
查看更多 立即下载
那么，我们可以期待什么呢？暴雪已确认，暴雪娱乐总裁 Johanna Faries 将与暴雪旗下所有系列的负责人一同出席开幕式，并发布“重大游戏公告”。最大的期待是暴雪会发布与 星际争霸 相关的内容，此前 星际争霸 官方网站上出现了奇怪的故障。这一明显的预热让这款著名的科幻即时战略系列的粉丝们兴奋不已，尤其是此前有报道称暴雪正在开发一款某种形式的 星际争霸 第一人称射击游戏。

World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft 的下一个重大资料片是 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: The Last Titan，它是继最近发布的 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: Midnight 之后，作为“世界之魂战记”的最终章。暴雪是会预告 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: The Last Titan，还是会更多地关注 World of 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft: Midnight 的后续内容？
预计 暗黑破坏岛 将在开幕式上大放异彩。暴雪表示，暗黑破坏岛 将“占据舞台中心，揭晓庇护之地辉煌未来的宏大计划”。我们是否能看到 暗黑破坏岛 4 新资料片或新职业的预告？
与此同时，Overwatch 的粉丝们正期待着新英雄的消息，因为暴雪今年计划发布10位新英雄的目标尚未完成。
此次发布会时长达75分钟，内容非常充实，足以让粉丝们感到兴奋。作为暴雪游戏的忠实粉丝，尤其是 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft 和 暗黑破坏岛，我非常希望能看到这两个系列的重大新闻。开幕式后还将举行开发者更新研讨会，资深玩家可以借此深入了解更多细节。

items.title: Level-5社长回应游戏发布会后的AI争议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260913/TQuGFpbucljkiti.png
开发商 Level-5 就其使用生成式人工智能（AI）的行为进行了道歉和说明，此前粉丝在 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village、DecaPolice 等游戏的画面中发现了“AI 废料”。
雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产
益智, 解谜, 冒险
查看更多 立即下载
在本周早些时候该工作室举行了类似任天堂直面会风格的发布会后，担忧开始浮现。这场名为“Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams”的发布会展示了即将推出的新作，但也出现了粉丝怀疑是生成式 AI 的多个案例。
观看这场 50 分钟发布会的观众花在讨论疑似 AI 使用证据上的时间，比讨论游戏本身的时间还多，比如 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 重制版、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 2: Haunted Domain 和 DecaPolice。引起争议的画面大多局限于背景场景，但粉丝们不得不质疑 Level-5 这一事实，已使这一局面演变成这家总部位于日本的工作室的全面争议。
妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团
幻想, 角色扮演
查看更多 立即下载
“噢不，Level-5 绝对是在使用生成式 AI 来‘更新’ 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产。尤其是将原版背景与新背景对比时。增加了这么多奇怪的细节和不一致之处。”
“在 Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain 的新预告片中，景太的……脸变了？！😭 上图为昨天（左）/ 今天（右）”
“当 Level-5 宣布带着 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产、DecaPolice、妖怪手表破坏者：赤猫团 等作品强势回归时，我非常兴奋，”一位社交媒体用户表示。“但看到这么多明目张胆的生成式 AI 被应用在他们的游戏中……是的，这不对劲。”
“你们曾是一家出色的工作室，”另一位粉丝说道。“现在你们对我们来说不过是令人失望。我们不想要这些 AI 垃圾。”
Level-5 社长兼 CEO 日野晃博也以自己的动画形象主持了这场发布会，他在社交平台上发文安抚舆论。他的信息既是道歉也是解释，确认了 Level-5 确实在开发的某些方面使用了生成式 AI。
日野将 Level-5 大量使用 AI 描述为“对最新技术的实验”，并补充说团队“向任何对此感到不适的人表示诚挚的歉意”。
“我原本对 DecaPolice 很感兴趣，但 Level-5 使用 AI 的行为让我感到恶心。我无法支持这一点。”
“但是，请放心，定义我们已发布作品魅力和个性的所有元素——如剧本、角色设计和基础设定——完全是由人手创作的，”日野表示。“我们主要利用 AI 来简化人造资产的数字化过程；例如，将原始艺术稿准确转换为 3D 多边形模型。您可以放心，我们发行的游戏不包含纯粹由 AI 生成的内容。”
日野还为 Level-5 目前使用 AI 的方式辩护，称：“通过 AI 驱动的效率提升所节省的时间，让我们的创作者能够将更多精力投入到真正的创意核心中。”对于他和团队其他成员来说，他们相信 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 等游戏的最终版本最终仍会令粉丝满意。这次如此依赖生成式 AI 的部分原因是希望能将“大作的开发周期从目前的五年缩短到两年”。
“尽管如此，我们不能否认这次广泛使用了 AI，这是出于希望呈现一个视觉冲击力强且易于理解的演示文档的渴望，”他继续说道。“我们将把这次经历作为未来的学习机会，所以请期待 Level-5 的下一次发布会。”
这一解释在 Level-5 社区反响不佳。帖子的回复中，粉丝们仍对开发过程中使用生成技术感到担忧，担心受影响的游戏将永远留下污点。
“生成式 AI 是科技公司利用无数艺术家被盗的作品进行训练以谋取利益的，其目的是取代艺术家，”一条热门回复称。“通过使用它，你们取代了艺术家。你们正在利用那些为了驱动该软件而被盗用的艺术家的技能获利。”
“我相信人心比上市速度更重要；不使用 AI 耗时五年肯定更好，”另一条日文帖子写道。“如果哪怕只有一个资产是用 AI 创建的，‘这个图像、这段音乐或这段对话是 AI 还是人类创作的？’这种挥之不去的担忧就永远不会消失。维护这种信任难道不是最重要的吗？”
日野没有就 Level-5 未来将如何调整开发计划提供具体的方案。目前，2007 年原版游戏的重制版 雷顿教授与超文明 A 的遗产 and the Curious Village 计划于 2027 年登陆 PC 和主机。该系列的另一款新作 the New World of Steam 将于今年 12 月发售。

items.summary: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, as the weekend event kicks off with a tradition

content.v: BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, as the weekend event kicks off with a traditional opening ceremony full of announcements and reveals for the company's biggest games. The show is about to begin, and if you're curious, we'll be keeping track of all the announcements as they happen for the 2026 edition.

While Blizzard hasn't revealed which of its games will be in the spotlight, we're expecting World of Warcraft, Overwatch, and Diablo to be today's main-eventers, and if we're lucky, we might even see StarCraft back in the spotlight. The show will run for around 75 minutes.

Blizzard president Johanna Faries had previously said that 2026 will be Blizzard’s "biggest year yet," with BlizzCon having a major part to play in those plans. You can keep scrolling below to read up on what Blizzard will show off, and we'll also be embedding trailers for each reveal, so don't forget to hit your F5 key for a quick refresh.

items.title: 粉丝在游戏展示会上大肆抨击后，5 级 Boss 解决了 AI 的强烈反对
items.summary: Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted 'AI slop' in fo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/professor-layton-and-the-new-world-of-steam-1789228310265.png
Developer Level-5 has apologized for and explained its use of generative AI after fans spotted "AI slop" in footage of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village , DecaPolice, and more.

Concerns emerged following the studio's Nintendo Direct-style presentation earlier this week. Dubbed Level5 Vision 2026 II: Dreams, the show came with first looks at upcoming games, and it also happened to feature what fans suspected to be multiple examples of genAI.

Those who tuned into the 50-minute presentation spent more time talking about what they believed was evidence of AI use rather than the games, such as the Professor Layton remake, Yo-Kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, and DecaPolice. The footage causing a stir is mostly limited to background scenes, but it's the fact that fans had to question Level-5 in the first place that's turned the situation into a full-fledged controversy for the Japan-based studio.

Oh no Level-5 is DEFINATELY using Gen AI to "update" Professor Layton. Especially when you compare the original backgrounds to the new. So many weird details and inconsistencies were added. https://t.co/AjVNfgetkk pic.twitter.com/0tRQ9vKn03
⁉️ Dans le nouveau trailer de Yo-kai Watch 2 : Haunted Domain, Nathan a… changé de visage ?! 😭 #YOKAIWATCH Hier (gauche) / Aujourd’hui (droite) pic.twitter.com/Vr3rzwNPA7

"I was SO excited when Level-5 announced their big comeback with Professor Layton, Decapolice, Yo-Kai Watch, and more," one fan on X/Twitter said . "But seeing this much blatant genAI being used across their games… yeah, this ain’t it"
"You were a beautiful studio," another fan said . "Now you are nothing more than a disappointment to us. We don’t want this AI s**t."

Level-5 president and CEO Akihiro Hino, who also hosted the showcase with his own animated avatar, took to X/Twitter to calm the noise. His message was both an apology and an explanation, confirming that Level-5 did, in fact, use generative AI for some aspects of development.
Hino described Level-5's heavy use of AI as "experimentation with the latest technology," adding that the team "sincerely apologizes to anyone who found this off-putting."
I was excited about Decapolice but Level-5 AI use is disgusting to me. I can't support that. https://t.co/EpxgBtCnDo

"However, please be assured that all elements defining the appeal and individuality of our released titles— such as the scenario, character designs, and foundational settings — are created entirely by human hands," Hino said (via Google translate). "We utilize AI primarily to streamline the process of digitizing human-created assets; for instance, accurately converting original artwork into 3D polygon models. You can rest assured that the games we release do not contain content simply generated by AI."

Hino also defended how Level-5 has used AI so far, saying: "the time saved through AI-driven efficiencies has allowed our creators to dedicate more of their efforts to the true essence of creativity." For him and the rest of the team, the belief is that the finished versions of games like Professor Layton and the Curious Village will still please fans in the end. Part of the reason it leaned so heavily on genAI this time around was so it could shrink "the development cycle for major titles from the current five years down to two."

"That said, we cannot deny that we made extensive use of AI this time, driven by a desire to deliver a presentation that was visually striking and easy to grasp," he continued. "We will take this experience as a learning opportunity for the future, so please look forward to Level-5’s next presentation."
pic.twitter.com/cict4COGTP

It's an explanation that hasn't gone over well in the Level-5 community. Replies to the post include fans still concerned about generative technology being used during development at all, fearing that affected games will be forever tarnished.

"Generative AI is trained on the stolen works of countless artists by tech companies to profit off their work, with the intent of replacing artists," one popular reply said . "By using it you replaced artists. You're profiting off of the skill of artists whose work has been stolen to power this software."

"I believe the human heart matters more than speed to market; surely it is better to take five years without using AI," another post written in Japanese said (via Google Translate). "If even a single asset is created using AI, the nagging worry — 'Is this image, piece of music, or line of dialogue made by AI or a human?' — would never go away. Isn't preserving that trust the most important thing?"

Hino didn't offer a specific game plan when it comes to how Level-5 will tweak its development plans going forward. For now, Professor Layton and the Curious Village, a remake of the original 2007 game, is slated to come to PC and consoles in 2027 . Another new game in the series, the New World of Steam , is due out this December.

content.v: Plus or minus?
10 new games are being added across PS Plus Extra and PS Plus Premium this month, but compared to August's super strong offering , I can see September's lineup being met with some criticism.

Honestly I'm not quite sure what the headline act is for Extra this time around. Co-op survival RPG RuneScape: Dragonwilds launches straight onto the subscription service — and it's highly rated on PC — but I can't see it appealing to everyone.
